thesis: The speaker argues that WCM Investment Management grew from a $200 million boutique in 1989 to managing over $40 billion by learning from past mistakes and treating failures as a source of strength. He illustrates this by recounting his early career mistake of swapping IBM for Digital Equipment based on growth for growth's sake, which taught him that the most rapidly growing companies can be massive destroyers of capital.
